posts.cooked: I just gave my re oppe. I was working in Powershell, and in the end switched my tab to the exam portal but it showed I was logged out. I am not sure how long I was logged out. What happens now?

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: You would be logged out at the end of the exam timings generally.

posts.name: Srishti Paul
posts.cooked: It was still I think 3-4 mins before deadline.
